title: Before we start
intro: Five short sections, about ten minutes. It saves as you type, so you can leave and come back. I do not know is a real answer to any of these.

questions.text: What does your business sell, in one line?
Where do you sell today?
Roughly how many orders a month?

options.label: I would rather say on a call

questions.text: Where does most of your traffic or footfall come from?
questions.help: Ads, search, word of mouth, marketplaces, a physical shop. Rough is fine.

questions.text: Who is your customer, in a sentence?
questions.help: Who they are, not who you wish they were.

sections.title: What is going wrong, and what you are running on

questions.text: What made you get in touch? In your words.
questions.help: Do not tidy it up for us. The messy version is the useful one.

questions.text: What have you already tried, and who has touched it before?
If this were fixed, what is different on a normal Tuesday?
questions.help: Fewer support messages, fewer refunds, one less thing you check at night.

questions.text: Your store runs on
Payments go through
Shipping goes through
Do you run ads today?
Do you ship outside India?
questions.help: Say more if yes. Where to, and how it goes.

questions.text: Your store's address
Screenshots of anything that annoys you about it
questions.help: On your phone, the way a customer sees it. Up to ten.

questions.text: Two or three stores you think get it right, and one line on why
Five words the store should feel like
Three words it must never feel like
Which of these feels closest to the mark you want?
Is there an existing logo?
questions.help: Whatever you have, in any format.

questions.text: Colours you are drawn to, and colours that are off-limits
questions.help: A reason helps, if there is one.

questions.text: Who else needs to see the work before you say yes?
questions.help: A partner, a brother who runs the ads, an investor. Better we know now.

questions.text: Anything in the next eight weeks we should build around?
questions.help: A sale, a launch, a festival, stock arriving. Dates if you have them.

questions.text: For quick things, how do you prefer we reach you?

access_items.label: Store platform staff account
access_items.help: Settings, Users, Add staff. Theme and order permissions.

access_items.label: Domain and DNS
access_items.help: Collaborator access, or say the word and we send you the records to paste in yourself.

access_items.label: Payment gateway, dashboard view only
access_items.help: The keys connect through the platform. They never travel by message.

access_items.label: Analytics and ads, agency access
access_items.help: Account level access to our agency account, not your personal login.

access_items.label: Brand files folder
access_items.help: A shared folder link. Logo, fonts, product photos.

questions.text: Who says yes on behalf of the business?
Their email
